title: SPECTRA: A Traceability Ontology for the 3GPP RAN Standardization Process
description:
SPECTRA is a reusable OWL 2 ontology and process knowledge graph for the 3GPP Radio Access Network (RAN) document lifecycle. It comprises 32 classes — 26 process-layer (Tdoc, Resolution, CR, LS, Section, Spec, TechnicalReport, TRImpact, Meeting, Company, WorkingGroup, ...) and 6 entity-layer — 53 object properties, and 81 data properties; it reuses Dublin Core, DCTERMS, and FOAF. The bundled per-WG body-text knowledge graphs cover all five RAN working groups (RAN1–RAN5; 0.97M nodes, 4.9M relationships, 12.9M RDF triples).

Version 2.0.0 adds SpectraCQ v2.0: a benchmark of 624 scored competency questions (654 authored; 30 held out), each pairing a natural-language question with an executable reference Cypher query (one file per CQ) and a deterministic gold answer set obtained by re-executing that query against the released graphs (624/624 self-replay; a 142-query SPARQL subset with 142/142 Cypher parity), together with the evaluation suite and a validation manifest mapping every quantitative claim of the accompanying paper to its supporting evidence file.

This release accompanies a paper that is currently under peer review. Two-tier release (see LICENSE for the authoritative text): (1) SPECTRA-authored components — the ontology, SHACL shapes, PyLODE documentation, SpectraCQ v2.0 (624 scored CQs), Cypher/SPARQL queries, synthetic and metadata-only examples, validation scripts, and the sanitized parsing pipeline — are released under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY 4.0). (2) The bundled per-WG body-text knowledge graphs are 3GPP-derived literals that are NOT relicensed as SPECTRA-authored content; they are redistributed with explicit 3GPP source attribution, following the academic redistribution practice established by TSpec-LLM and the GSMA telecom-kg-rel19 release. Original PDFs remain freely accessible at https://www.3gpp.org/ftp/.
